name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: Editing a member no longer leaves a duplicate behind. Changing someone's Member ID used to add a second entry under the new ID while the old one stayed in the list — two rows for the same person, both showing the same transactions. Deleting a member sticks now as well, instead of the entry reappearing a moment later.

Three members who had already been split into two entries this way have been put back together, keeping every transaction. The Member ID and name you type when editing are also trimmed now, so a stray space at the end can't quietly create a separate record.

Every dropdown in the app now jumps as you type. Open one, start typing, and a few letters is usually enough to land on what you want instead of scrolling — press the same letter again to step through the entries that start with it.

The same bank account or PayID can no longer be added to the Blacklist Member list twice. If you type one that's already there, the form tells you straight away who it's listed under and won't let it be saved again.

Phone numbers work differently on purpose: if a number is already on the list you'll see a note saying who it belongs to, but you can still save. One person is often reported under several different names on the same number, and those are all worth recording.

The Blacklist Member page is easier to read: everything about a person now fits on screen without dragging left and right, and the list is paged like the Members directory — 50 at a time by default, or pick 100, 200, 500 or 1000.

New Blacklist Member page in the sidebar, starting with 3,441 imported records. Unlike every other page, this list is SHARED — every company in the same country sees the same entries, so anything you report shows up for them and theirs shows up for you. Anyone can add. Entries can never be edited, and only a master can remove one.

When you record a transaction, the name and phone fields now warn you if that person is on the blacklist — showing what they were reported for and by whom. It's only a warning: it never blocks you from saving the entry.

The console team list now shows who's signed in right now — a green "Online" dot with the address they're connected from, or "Last seen 20 minutes ago" plus the address they last signed in from for anyone who isn't. Only master and manager accounts can see this.
Staff accounts no longer have the CSV, Excel and PDF download buttons. Owners, masters and managers still export as before.

On the Members page, the "Newest joined" and "Oldest joined" sort options now follow each member's Joined date. Pick "Oldest joined" to put your longest-standing members at the top, or "Newest joined" for the most recent sign-ups first. (Members who joined on the same day keep the order they were entered in.)
The How-to guide now covers the Search page as well: what each of the six filters does, and the fact that typing a number in the keyword box matches an amount exactly rather than partly.

It also flags two things that are easy to miss — the CSV, Excel and PDF buttons export exactly what your filters are showing (so filter first), and the row of totals above the results only appears once you set a From or To date.
English, 中文 (Chinese) and ភាសាខ្មែរ (Khmer), same as the rest of the guide — open it from your account menu or the "?" button.
